name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for the PC port

Make sure you give a relevant title to this feature request. 

Did you check if there was already a feature request for this?

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of what you'd like to see. Why should the maintainers bother with this? How will this improve the player's experience? 

Does this fit with the goal of the PC port? Are you asking for something which should be a mod instead?
